title: _testdata Launches TC104 BLDC Motor Controller
summary: _testdata announces the launch of TC104, an advanced BLDC motor controller with FOC algorithm support for industrial automation.
content: _testdata Inc. today announced the launch of TC104, a new BLDC motor controller with field-oriented control support. The TC104 is designed for industrial automation applications requiring precise motor control with 48V/10A rated output.

title: New TC103 ADC Converter Available for Sampling
summary: The TC103 12-bit SAR ADC with 1MSPS sampling rate is now available for customer sampling through authorized distributors.
content: _testdata Inc. announced that the TC103 12-bit SAR ADC is now available for customer sampling. The device features 1MSPS sampling rate with 8-channel multiplexer and SPI interface.

title: _testdata Achieves ISO 26262 ASIL-D Certification
summary: _testdata has achieved ISO 26262 ASIL-D certification for its automotive product line, reinforcing commitment to functional safety.
content: _testdata Inc. announced it has achieved ISO 26262 ASIL-D certification for its automotive product line, the highest level of functional safety for automotive systems.
